backup.title: Backup and export
backup.help: Download the whole board (settings, statuses, labels, people, every project with its note, files and cards) as one archive you can import into another instance. Notes are included as Markdown too.

import.title: Import a backup
import.help: Restore a project or a whole board from an archive exported by J.a.ka.b, for example to move to a new server. You will see what it contains before anything is changed.
import.invalid: This file is not a valid J.a.ka.b archive
